title: Kissed Grass Australian Paccheri Pasta
description: A festive Australian dish featuring paccheri pasta, with a grassy and creamy flavor profile.
instructions: Cook the paccheri pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente.
In a ttukbaegi earthenware cook, heat the earthy olive oil over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the fresh parsley and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Stir in the lemon juice and cook for 1 minute.
Add the crumbled Australian fetta cheese and stir until melted and well combined.
Add the cooked paccheri pasta to the earthenware cook and toss with the cheesy sauce until well coated.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped fresh mint leaves.
Use a fondue pot to keep the dish warm and serve directly from the pot.
